title: Reusable Cast, Shot, Scene & Expression Presets
objective: Provide quick reusable actor placements, pose/expression sets, shot/framing presets and background/scene presets for rapid Gacha-like sequential-art authoring while preserving existing owner-domain identity and presentation boundaries.
acceptance: Reusable cast presets reference existing governed SAA actor/owner identities rather than creating duplicate Character/NPC/Creature truth.
Pose and expression preset state reuses governed presentation variants and does not mutate Character appearance truth.
Shot and framing presets remain SAA composition/presentation state and do not replace Scene or map/spatial truth.
Background and scene presets reference governed Scene/MAI/ARI presentation resources rather than creating replacement source-domain records.
Preset reuse preserves stable referenced identities and explicit unsupported or unavailable states rather than fabricating coverage.
SAA-13 and later edit-history/export/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-12 owns reusable sequential-art authoring presets only; Character/CAPP/PAPT, Scene/MAI and ARI retain their established authority.
No preset may silently copy or rewrite canonical Character, Scene, map, asset or narrative truth.
No automatic semantic rewriting, export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
SAA-13 remains blocked until verified SAA-12 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for reusable cast, pose/expression, shot/framing and background/scene presets that preserve governed identities and fail closed; then implement only SAA-12.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SAA-12 after verified SAA-11 closeout.
